name: Concrete-Face Rockfill Rockfill Dam
title: Concrete-Face Rockfill Rockfill Dam
description: Concrete-Face Rockfill Rockfill Dam is a complete rockfill dam blueprint record in this database, covering the full plan set from site layout to final details. The design calls for 150 ft high dam with 700 ft crest and concrete face slabs, built from Compacted rockfill shells in lifts. Face slabs take water load to rockfill. Settlement of face monitored. The plan sheets include cross-section sheets, face slab and joint details, and plinth and grout plans. Taught at ladder rank 1 of 20 (Foundations): core concepts, parts, and safe building practices. Signature-line original design by the JAH system; verify against local codes before building.
dimensions: 150 ft high dam with 700 ft crest and concrete face slabs
structural_notes: Face slabs take water load to rockfill. Settlement of face monitored.
